description: Watch state for Marvel Star Wars (1977 series) issues #2 and #6, CGC 9.8 only.

items.description: Marvel Star Wars #2 (1977) CGC 9.8 White Pages, first comic appearance of Jabba the Hutt's original design. Historical Heritage lot #12409.
Marvel Star Wars #2 (1977) CGC 9.8 White Pages, Twin Cities Pedigree copy. Historical Heritage lot #11329, Sunday Internet Comics Auction.
Marvel Star Wars #6 (1977) CGC 9.8 White Pages. Historical Heritage lot #13353. Possibly covered by a Bleeding Cool article noting an in-progress bid of $210 before close.

items.price: not shown (bulk lot, no per-issue price)
items.description: Bulk lot 'Star Wars #1-107 And More (Marvel, 1977-1996)': complete run of the original 1977-1986 Marvel series plus 1995-96 reprint, 3 annuals, Return of the Jedi #1-4, and Marvel Movie Showcase #1-2, every book CGC 9.8 (mostly white pages). Includes #2 and #6 at 9.8 but not sold/priced as standalone single-issue lots.
